name: Taly Payment
author: Taly

sections.description:
Make shopping smarter with Taly.
Split your purchases into 3 or 4 payments, interest-free — always 0% interest | 100% Shariah-compliant.

How it works

  • Shop your favorite brands – Add items to your cart and choose Taly at checkout.
  • Instant approval – Sign up in seconds, link any debit or credit card, and get approved instantly.
  • Choose your payments – Pay just the upfront, with the rest spread over time. No hidden fees, no interest.
  • Peace of mind – On-time payments mean you’ll never pay extra.

Key Benefits

  • Instant approval with any card
  • Simple, transparent, and easy to use.

WooCommerce Subscriptions

Currently, this plugin does not support WooCommerce Subscriptions.

Documentation

https://docs.taly.io/?utm_source=chatgpt.com/
